# Code review: `2480a28...HEAD` (41 files, +159 −2050)

**Verdict: OK to open the PR. Fix F2 first.** No blocking findings. Two P2 test-reliability issues were each checked by a validate agent and a refute agent; the rest are P3 or cleanups. The review was read-only: I ran no tests and changed no files.

The diff is 38 Cypress files and 3 web source files, at HEAD `353ac6f`. The `...` range compares against the merge-base `7a3b6d2`, not the SHA given. Most of the diff (~1,900 lines) deletes Cypress specs.

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| Overall | ~91/100 (approximate, see "How this was produced") · 3 of 6 findings adjudicated |
| Held the score down | Race in the new single-space redirect helpers; non-repeatable "add manually" test |
| Fix first | **F2**: the one-shot `cy.url()` check after `cy.wait('@spacesList')` |

## Scores by area

| Area | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Bugs | 88 | F2 |
| Testing | 84 | F1, F3 |
| DRY | 97 | F4 |
| KISS | 97 | F5 |
| Regression | 100 | Renamed test IDs are fully migrated (see "Checked and clean") |
| Conventions | 100 | Nothing that breaks a written repo rule |
| Security / Architecture / Performance | n/a | Test-only code plus a `data-testid` rename and a wrapper `<div>` |

## Findings (P2)

**F2 · Bugs · P2 · CONFIRMED (validator confirmed it, refuter couldn't break it)**
`apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:233` and `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:665`
- **What:** `goToSpacesView()` and `openFirstSpaceFromSpacesView()` wait for `@spacesList`, then read `cy.url()` once inside `.then()`. That read doesn't retry.
- **Why it's wrong:** The single-space redirect doesn't happen when the network response arrives. It happens later, in a `useEffect` in `useSignInRedirect.ts:53-86` that calls `router.push`, after React has rendered the spaces list. Nothing hides `org-list` while this happens (`SpacesList/index.tsx:273-280`).
- **What breaks:** For an account with exactly one space, the URL check can still see `/welcome/spaces` and skip the logo click. Then the redirect lands on the dashboard, and the next `orgList, createSpaceBtn` check either fails or passes on a page that is about to disappear. The helper doesn't reliably handle the case it was written for.
- **Fix:** Wait until the page is in one of its two final states, then branch. For example, wait for the dashboard marker or the org list with a retrying `.should()`. Or have `cy.url().should(...)` retry until it matches either `/spaces?spaceId=` or the list is visible.

**F1 · Testing · P2 · Adjusted (the original claim was refuted; both agents agreed on this version)**
`apps/web/cypress/e2e/regression/spaces_basicflow.cy.js:50` → `apps/web/cypress/e2e/pages/spaces.page.js:554`
- **What:** "Verify an account can be added manually" no longer creates a fresh space. It adds `SEP_STATIC_SAFE_35` to the admin's *first existing* staging space and never cleans up.
- **What breaks:** On any rerun that picks the same space, the Safe is already there. `AddAccounts` leaves it out of the selection (`AddAccounts/index.tsx:56-64`), so `isFormDirty` stays false and the submit button stays disabled (`:494`). `addAccountsBtn.should('be.enabled')` then times out. The test isn't repeatable, and it keeps changing a shared, persistent space.
- **Fix:** Remove the Safe at the end of the test, or go back to a throwaway space that gets deleted afterwards.

## Findings (P3)

| ID | Area | Location | Finding | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F3 | Testing | `spaces.page.js:517` | `cy.wait(2000)` followed by a one-shot `$body.find(spaceCard).length` check. The old `cy.get('body').find(spaceCard)` retried; this doesn't. The race window is small because `goToSpacesView()` already waits for `@spacesList`. The trade was deliberate: the old retry hung when the account had no spaces. A retrying check that passes on either state would fix both. | Contested (one agent: partial; the other: weakened) |
| F4 | DRY | `spaces.page.js:232-238`, `spaces.page.js:664-670` | The same "wait for spaces → if on dashboard, click logo → assert spaces URL" block appears twice. Pull it into one helper (that also fixes F2 in one place). | Not adjudicated |
| F5 | KISS | `spaces.page.js:163, 202, 210, 279, 337, 365, 369`; `fixtures/spaces/staticSpaces.js:23-41` | Helpers used only by the deleted specs now have no callers: `getPendingTxItem`, `signOutViaSidebarProfile`, `verifyOnSingleSpaceDashboard`, `clickExpandedPanelSubAccountRow`, `verifyAccountRowDetails`, `verifyExpandedPanelSubAccountRowsCount`, `verifyAccountExpandedPanelVisible`. The fixture's `unnamedAccount*`, `multichainAccount*` and `multichainSubAccounts` fields are also unused. `accountsWidgetRowCount: 9` contradicts the `3` the test asserts. | Not adjudicated |

## Worth tidying (no score impact)

1. **Leaked space:** `spaces_basicflow.cy.js:64`. The invite test creates a space and never deletes it, so the admin account drifts toward the 10-space limit. This pushes `ensureReadyToCreateSpace` into deleting whichever space is first. The leak predates this change, but it affects F1, F2 and F3.
2. **Hard waits and forced clicks:** `spaces_basicflow.cy.js:72-77` (`cy.wait(3000)` then visiting the same page again) and `spaces.page.js:537-544` (`click({ force: true })` right after asserting the element is visible and enabled). The forced click can hide a real overlay regression.
3. **Dead sidebar helpers:** `cypress/e2e/pages/sidebar.pages.js`. With 11 sidebar specs deleted, many of its helpers probably have no callers now. Not checked one by one.

To act on these: **fix**, **ticket** or **skip** them all (the default is skip).

## Checked and clean

- **Renamed test IDs:** `add-space-account-button` → `open-add-accounts-chooser-button` on the chooser's trigger. The old ID was shared with the trigger inside `AddAccounts` (`AddAccounts/index.tsx:384`), and the rename separates them. The unit tests and Cypress are updated. Nothing in Playwright (`apps/web/e2e`) or other source files references it.
- **`pinned-accounts` moved from the header to a wrapper `<div>`** (`AccountsModal/index.tsx:53`). The parent scroll container isn't flex or grid, so layout is unaffected. `index.test.tsx:136` and every use of `pinnedAccounts` in `accounts_modal.pages.js` still work, and the checks at lines 39 and 162-163 are more precise now.
- **Deleted specs** were all fully skipped (`describe.skip` or only `it.skip`). One also contained an `it.only` inside a `describe.skip`. The `it.only` removed from `spaces_basicflow` stops it from silently skipping sibling tests.
- **Removed Spaces dashboard E2E tests:** `Dashboard/__tests__/PendingTxWidget.test.tsx` exists, which supports the "covered by unit tests" claim.
- **Other selectors:** `member-invitee-identifier-input` is on the `<input>` itself, so dropping `.find('input')` is correct. `logo-container`, `constants.spacesEndpoint` and `singleAccountName` all exist. The spaces request is skipped until the user signs in, so `@spacesList` can't be satisfied by an earlier request.
- **Assets test comment** matches `smoke/assets.cy.js:42-49`.

## Not covered

- I ran no Cypress or unit tests. Everything here comes from reading the code.
- The staging state (how many spaces the admin account has) is unknown, so how often F1 and F2 actually fire isn't measured.
- F4, F5 and the cleanups weren't adjudicated. They still count at full weight in the score.

## How this was produced

I built the scope and repo profile, then did the nine category passes myself rather than with nine parallel agents. The three strongest findings each went to one validate agent and one refute agent, six agents in all. The refute agent overturned F1's original claim that the test "passes vacuously" and F1 was reframed. F2 held up. F3 is contested. Scores are my own estimate using the review's deduction model; the `review-score` skill wasn't run.
